  ∀ (ε : Real),

            @LT.lt.{0} Int Int.instLTInt (@OfNat.ofNat.{0} Int (nat_lit 0) (@instOfNat (nat_lit 0))) q →
              @LT.lt.{0} Real Real.instLT
                (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real

                  (@HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHPow.{0, 0} Real Real Real.instPow)
                    (@Int.cast.{0} Real Real.instIntCast q)
                    (@HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHAdd.{0} Real Real.instAdd)

                  (@HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real (@instHSub.{0} Real Real.instSub) x
                    (@HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} Real Real Real
                      (@instHDiv.{0} Real (@DivInvMonoid.toDiv.{0} Real Real.instDivInvMonoid))
                      (@Int.cast.{0} Real Real.instIntCast p) (@Int.cast.{0} Real Real.instIntCast q)))))
